mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism is always active and does not require additional conditions.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 18500 billion dollars and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains below 250, the economy is in a sweet spot of robust growth without inflationary pressure, reducing the likelihood of aggressive monetary policy and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 > 18500 and CPIAUCSL < 250.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals an early economic slowdown, reducing corporate output and profit expectations, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPIAUCSL above 250 (index) over the prior month signals inflationary pressure that may lead to central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1150 (thousands of units) over the prior month signals weak consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1150.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) above 149000 and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.9% over the prior month signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer income and spending, which supports corporate profits and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 149000 and UNRATE < 3.9.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% over the prior month indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers the cost of capital and stimulates investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.
